title: Signature Pad
content: Build signature capture component. Canvas: drawing area for signature. Drawing: pen/touch input creates signature. Clear: button to reset and try again. Save: capture as image data. Type: optional typed signature alternative. Upload: option to upload signature image. Validation: ensure signature is not empty. Preview: show captured signature.

variants.simple: Create signature input with drawing canvas.
variants.detailed: Build signature capture component. Canvas: drawing area for signature. Drawing: pen/touch input creates signature. Clear: button to reset and try again. Save: capture as image data. Type: optional typed signature alternative. Upload: option to upload signature image. Validation: ensure signature is not empty. Preview: show captured signature.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive signature capture component. Canvas element: HTML5 canvas for drawing, responsive sizing (full width, aspect ratio ~3:1). Drawing input: mouse drawing (mousedown, mousemove, mouseup), touch support (touchstart, touchmove, touchend), pressure sensitivity if available. Stroke styling: smooth line with variable width (based on speed or pressure), anti-aliased, appropriate color (dark gray or blue). Clear button: reset canvas to empty, confirm if signature exists. Undo: optional undo last stroke. Type alternative: toggle to typed signature mode, cursive/signature font rendering, text input field. Upload option: allow uploading existing signature image, crop/resize to fit. Save format: toDataURL() as PNG or JPEG base64, or toBlob() for upload. Empty validation: check if canvas has been drawn on (track drawing events or check canvas pixels). Preview: after save, show signature preview with option to redo. Placeholder: light watermark text "Sign here" that disappears on first stroke. Line smoothing: bezier curve smoothing for natural strokes. Mobile optimization: prevent scroll while signing, adequate canvas size for finger. Date stamp: optionally add date below signature automatically. Annotation: optional name or title text field below signature. Legal text: checkbox for agreement before signing, timestamp capture. Signature comparison: optional overlay of previous signature for verification. Accessibility: keyboard alternative for those unable to draw, describe interaction. Download: option to download signature as PNG file. Storage: save signature data URL to form state for submission.
